intent: Teach tool-purpose uncertainty, handle direction, long-spoon versus spoonful, one chopstick passing through, each versus one and beside versus on, drinks on a tray, refill-before-walk and a clean jar with jam inside.
picturePurpose: Original tray illustration teaches the observable on relation only; exact labels and targets are code-owned. Still art does not prove carrying or real source quantity.

transfer.stem: 换成刷子、骑车和碗，哪组三句保留了全部要求？
transfer.passage:
新要求
递刷子（brush）时把刷柄（handle）朝向我。骑车前把水瓶重新灌满。在每个碗（bowl）旁放一张垫子（mat）。

options.text: Pass the brush with the handle facing away from me. Refill your bottle before the ride. Place a mat beside each bowl.
Pass the brush with the handle facing me. Refill your bottle after the ride. Place a mat beside each bowl.
Pass the brush with the handle facing me. Refill your bottle before the ride. Place a mat beside only one bowl.
Pass the brush with the handle facing me. Refill your bottle before the ride. Place a mat beside each bowl.

answer.display: Pass the brush with the handle facing me. Refill your bottle before the ride. Place a mat beside each bowl.

explanation.strategy: 逐一核对朝向、顺序与each的覆盖范围。

steps.text: 刷柄朝向我：with the handle facing me。
steps.reason: away from me变成背向，改变朝向。

steps.text: 骑车前重新装水：Refill…before the ride。
steps.reason: after the ride把要求改成事后。

steps.text: 每个碗旁都放垫子：beside each bowl。
steps.reason: only one bowl丢掉每个的范围。

distractors.reason: away from me改变了刷柄朝向。
after the ride颠倒先装水后骑车的顺序。
only one bowl不能保留each bowl。

explanation.pitfall: with、before和each分别锁定朝向、顺序与范围，不能只认出名词。

visual.title: 三个要求，分别核对
visual.caption: 不反朝向、不倒顺序、不漏对象。
